title: Openrouter Fusion API
summary: OpenRouter Fusion API is a unified API gateway that aggregates multiple LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta, etc.) into a single interface, allowing developers to access and intelligently route requests across different AI models through one API.
problem_solved: Eliminates the need for developers to manage multiple API integrations and billing systems for different AI model providers by providing a single unified endpoint.
why_valuable: It simplifies multi-model AI application development with built-in cost optimization, automatic failover, and unified billing while maintaining compatibility with existing OpenAI-style codebases.
